releaseNotes:
✨ What's new in v2.9:
• 🌐 External Browser Integration: All external links from Stack Overflow, Dev.to, Medium, GitHub repositories, and Bookmarks now open directly in your device's default external browser.
• 🔑 Seamless GitHub OAuth: Fixed GitHub authorization & OAuth connect flow to launch safely in system browser.
• ⚡ Performance & Stability: Enhanced native Android WebView handling and custom scheme navigation.
• 🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements.
